audit_scope: baseline_state is the default-branch source at baseline_main_sha. implementation_state is the tree that contains this file. Implementation state is read from source and its regression tests; it is not exact-head certification, and no row has been exercised with a live model.

rows.gap: One run is active per conversation and conversations run independently. Not exercised: several live-model runs at once against one model server, or any limit on simultaneous runs.

The reply-format contract travels in relayed prompts only (the four deterministic choices and the proposed vector). A first typed message does not carry it, no conversation-level contract reaches the system prompt, the built-in mock answerer never writes a block, and no local, remote or Anthropic model has been run against the contract.

Every fenced block and the proposed vector have a copy control. Rendered evidence is Chromium at desktop and phone width with a scripted model; WebKit and the selection-copy fallback on a phone over plain http were not exercised for these controls.

One Start sends the proposed vector as the next message in ask-first mode, with the exact text shown beforehand. That message is the block inside a fixed provenance line and the reply-format contract, not the bare block; pasting the copied block sends it bare. The relay exists on the conversation run bus only: the CLI `conversations ask` command and POST /conversations/{id}/ask produce no proposals.

A proposal submits nothing and approves nothing, and a block containing a slash-command line is withheld. No automatic or budgeted relay exists, by contract (execution-entry N14); adding one needs its own authorization contract.

A second conversation can be started while the first works, and the list shows which conversations hold a vector. Exercised with two conversations and a scripted model; the recorded five-conversation pass with live models was not reproduced, and no single view starts vectors across conversations.

Thread status comes from run records. Which results were seen is kept per browser, so a phone and a desktop do not share it. The list is polled only while a run is active, so a run started from another device appears on the next list load. There is no push notification.
Present before this denominator: run state, stop, and a queue for follow-up messages. How long a run worked is not shown on its answer.
Conversations are listed by last update with a text filter. Nothing can be pinned.

A chat model can propose search, fetch and render actions, capped at 6 steps per run (12 with a repository). Every network action waits for an approval, so an unattended conversation parks at AWAITING_APPROVAL and is listed as needing approval. Auto mode pre-approves local read-only actions only, and only for a model that runs on this machine. Run-scoped permission leases, Autopilot budgets and the supervisor-queue primitives exist but are not connected to conversation runs.
Present before this denominator: citations with an evidence panel, and a reply with no matching source is marked as using none. Not re-certified for relayed vector runs.

Gate rows are parsed and shown as the model's claims with verified=false. They are not compared with execution-entry gate evidence or release receipts, a claimed PASS is checked against nothing, and whether a model keeps unverified gates OPEN or WITHHELD is not measured.

Each proposal carries the SHA-256 of its text and the run that wrote it, and each answer trace is exported by run. There is no per-conversation ledger of frozen baselines that a vector can name or that checks a preserve-exact-hash step, and a relayed run is not linked to the proposal it started from. The model receives a compacted summary plus at most 8 recent turns, each cut to 320 characters, so a long relay depends on the block itself to carry state.
The loop was driven at iPhone 14 width in Chromium with touch emulation. WebKit, an installed phone browser, and phone access over a private network were not exercised for the relay.
